import re

with open('дані/текст.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    text = f.read()

sentences = []
for part in re.split(r'[.!?]+', text):
    words = re.findall(r'[^\W\d_]+', part)
    if words:
        sentences.append(words)

indexed = [(i + 1, w) for i, w in enumerate(sentences)]
top = sorted(indexed, key=lambda x: (-len(x[1]), x[0]))[:3]

for k, w in top:
    print(f"№{k} ({len(w)} слів): {' '.join(w[:3])}")
